item.title: Amazon driver rescues 84-year-old woman from Harford County house fire
item.description: WHITEFORD, MD – An Amazon delivery driver is being hailed as a hero after pulling an 84-year-old woman to safety during a house fire in Harford County this week. According to the Maryland State Fire Marshal’s Office, the woman was home alone in the basement of her Whiteford residence when her dog began barking, alerting her to the fire. item.title: Police seek suspect who opened fire near Beach 90th Street in Queens
item.description: QUEENS, NY – The NYPD is asking for the public’s help identifying a gunman who fired multiple shots at a busy intersection in the Rockaways earlier this month before fleeing the scene. According to police, the incident occurred around 6:14 p.m. on February 3 at the intersection of Beach 90th Street and Beach Channel Drive, within the 100th Precinct. item.title: NYPD searching for suspect who assaulted MTA bus driver in Brooklyn
item.description: BROOKLYN, NY – Police are asking for the public’s help identifying a man wanted in connection with an assault on an MTA bus driver in East Flatbush earlier this month. According to the NYPD Crime Stoppers unit, the attack occurred around 5:25 p.m. on January 12, when a 48-year-old male MTA bus driver stopped a B35 bus in front of 3016 Church Avenue, within the 67th Precinct. item.title: Former Maryland police chief gets added 55-year sentence for decade-long arson spree
item.description: ELLICOTT CITY, MD – A former Maryland police chief already serving multiple life sentences for a string of revenge-motivated arsons will spend even more time behind bars after pleading guilty to additional fire-setting charges in Montgomery County. David Crawford, 74, of Ellicott City, was sentenced Friday to 55 years in prison after admitting to setting multiple fires at his stepson’s Clarksburg home between 2016 and 2020.
